title: Story manifest
description: stories/<channel>/<id>/manifest-<hash>.json on the content host: every file of one version of a story, written by `story package`. The app downloads every file it lists (the pictures, and every language's text, clips and timings), and checks each file's size and SHA-256. See docs/story-format.md, "Published stories".

images.description: Image id → its file. The same in every language. An image that isn't here shows the app's placeholder (dev only).

languages.description: Each language: its story/<lang>.json, clip id → file for its narration (empty until it's narrated), and the timings of its narrated pages.

timings.description: timings-<lang>-<hash>.json, once a page's clip is here: {"format": 1, "clips": {<page id>: [[start, end], …]}}, when each word of the page's text (each run of non-space characters, in order) starts and ends in its clip, in milliseconds. Measured by `story package` from the clip (storytool/timings.py).

files.description: Every file named above: its size and SHA-256.
